about.title: About
about.p1: Star Trail Demo is a prototype for sharing artist bios and update timelines with friends. It doesn't represent any artist, agency, or official fan club.
about.p2: Information is compiled from public, checkable sources, and every update includes a source link. If something is wrong or infringes rights, please ask for a correction or removal.
about.li1: No private addresses, travel plans, or family details
about.li2: No fundraising, ranking campaigns, or third-party boosting
about.li3: The play-request demo only covers seeds, challenges, co-op, and on-stream requests — not rank boosting
about.li4: Avatars stay as text or outbound links to avoid hosting images without permission
about.li5: Browsing is free for now; paid memberships would be announced separately

fabInvestigate.title: AI line investigation
fabInvestigate.intro: Describe what you see. The agent calls read-only tools for the fab summary, batches, and alerts, searches the knowledge base (SOPs, alert runbooks, past incidents) when needed, then drafts an Action Plan (symptoms / likely causes / next actions / data to confirm).
fabInvestigate.placeholder: e.g. Etch Chamber B7 yield drop — check alerts and draft an Action Plan
examples: Etch Chamber B7 yield is dropping — check alerts and draft an Action Plan
Why is batch B-240909-01 below the control limit?
Which critical alerts are still open? Prioritize next actions
How should an ETCH-PARTICLE alert be handled per procedure? Has B7 had this before?
fabInvestigate.shortcutHint: Ctrl + Enter to send · Cloud by default, falls back to local if cloud is unavailable

fabKnowledge.title: Knowledge search lab
fabKnowledge.intro: The retrieval pipeline behind the investigate agent's search_fab_knowledge tool: BM25 keyword search and vector search each recall candidates, RRF merges the rankings, then the model scores every candidate section 0–3 and drops the irrelevant ones. Each stage's ranking is listed below for comparison.
fabKnowledge.placeholder: e.g. What leak rate is required after a chamber wet clean?
examples: The ETCH-RF-DRIFT alert is acknowledged. Do we still need to act on it?
What leak rate is required after a chamber wet clean?
Has chamber B7 had a particle-related yield incident before?
What time does the cafeteria open?

stageHints.bm25: Exact matches on alert codes, document IDs and parameter names; Chinese is split into character bigrams.
stageHints.vector: Semantic match: paraphrases and Chinese ↔ English still find the passage.
stageHints.fused: Merges the two rankings (Σ 1/(60 + rank)) without calibrating their scores.
stageHints.rerank: The model reads query and passage together; anything below 2 is dropped.

fabKnowledge.abstained: The reranker found nothing relevant, so the result is empty and the agent cites no document.
fabKnowledge.notReranked: Not reranked: the top fused sections are used, keeping only BM25 matches or sections whose vector similarity clears the floor.
fabKnowledge.rerankFailed: Rerank failed, using the fused ranking:
fabKnowledge.filterRelaxed: The filter matched no document and was relaxed.
fabKnowledge.translatedHint: Retrieved from the source document; shown in the language of the question. Original heading:

aiRuns.title: AI runs
aiRuns.intro: Every call to /api/ai/chat is logged: local vs cloud, whether it fell back, time to first token, total latency, tool calls, guardrail hits, token usage and cost, and user feedback. Stats cover the latest 500 runs.
aiRuns.empty: No runs yet. Generate something in the AI assistant first.
aiRuns.costNote: Costs are estimated at ${in} input / ${out} output per 1M tokens (override with CLOUD_PRICE_* env vars). Local calls are free; "saved" = local tokens × cloud price. Free-tier usage actually costs $0.
aiRuns.latencyNote: Latency counts successful model runs only; errors, stopped runs and cache hits are excluded.
aiRuns.guardrailEmpty: No guardrail hits in recent runs.
aiRuns.tierNote: The cloud model is picked by difficulty: multi-entity comparisons, causal questions and long inputs are rated complex and go to the strong model; the rest use the standard model. If the standard model's Action Plan fails validation or cites IDs that are not in the data, it is retried on the strong model. Cost is priced per model.

aiTrace.title: Run trace
aiTrace.intro: The full call chain of one run: input guardrails, routing, every attempt (including fallback), each model call and tool call, and the output checks — with timing, time to first token, tokens and cost per step.
aiTrace.noSpans: This run has no trace: it was recorded before tracing existed, or its spans were pruned (only the latest 1000 runs keep traces).
